items.question: Within how many days of a worker's arrival in the UAE must the employment contract be submitted to the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE)?
items.gold: Within 14 days of the employee's arrival in the UAE.
items.fact: Employment contract submitted to MoHRE within 14 days of arrival

items.question: Under the UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021), what is the maximum length in years of a fixed-term employment contract?
items.gold: A fixed term not exceeding three years.
items.fact: UAE Labour Law fixed-term employment contract maximum is three years
